name: talkremind
title: TalkRemind
description: Pause TalkRemind, manage the apps it ignores and read your dictation statistics from Raycast. Requires the TalkRemind menu bar app.
author: IngoJ

commands.name: pause-until
commands.title: Pause Until
commands.subtitle: TalkRemind
commands.description: Pause TalkRemind for a while or until a time, or resume it. Type a time like 15:30 or a length like 45m.

commands.name: toggle-pause
commands.title: Toggle Pause
commands.subtitle: TalkRemind
commands.description: Pause TalkRemind, or resume it when it is paused. Handy for a hotkey.

preferences.name: pauseFor
preferences.title: Pause For
preferences.description: How long this command pauses TalkRemind.

commands.name: excluded-apps
commands.title: Excluded Apps
commands.subtitle: TalkRemind
commands.description: See which apps TalkRemind ignores, and exclude or include any installed app.

commands.name: toggle-frontmost-app
commands.title: Exclude or Include Frontmost App
commands.subtitle: TalkRemind
commands.description: Exclude the app you are in from TalkRemind, or include it again.

commands.name: statistics
commands.title: Statistics
commands.subtitle: TalkRemind
commands.description: Your dictation share today, this week and over the last 7 days, time saved and the apps TalkRemind reminded you in.

preferences.name: closeAfterApply
preferences.title: Window
preferences.label: Close Raycast after a change
preferences.description: Off keeps the list open so you can keep adjusting.

tools.name: get-status
tools.title: Get Status
tools.description: Read whether TalkRemind is paused and until when, which apps it ignores, and a short statistics summary (today, this week, time saved, reminders today). Use get-usage for any analysis of typing and dictation habits.

tools.name: get-usage
tools.title: Get Usage
tools.description: Read how much the user typed and dictated over the last N days (1 = today, 7, 30, up to 90): totals, day by day, and for every app the typed words, dictated words, dictation share, typing runs, reminders shown and how many of them were followed.

tools.name: pause
tools.title: Pause TalkRemind
tools.description: Pause TalkRemind's reminders for a number of minutes (up to 7 days), until this evening, until tomorrow morning, or until further notice.

tools.name: resume
tools.title: Resume TalkRemind
tools.description: End a pause so TalkRemind reminds again.

tools.name: set-app-excluded
tools.title: Exclude or Include App
tools.description: Exclude an app from TalkRemind (no reminders, left out of the statistics) or include it again. Takes the app's name or bundle identifier.

ai.instructions: TalkRemind is a Mac menu bar app that reminds people to dictate instead of typing long text. Use get-usage to answer questions about habits: which apps get the most typing or dictation, how a period compares with another (call it again with a different number of days), which apps TalkRemind reminded in and how often the reminder was followed. Typing data is kept for 30 days, so longer periods only show dictation. Typed words are an estimate from characters. Excluded apps are left out of every figure. When asked for advice, base it on the numbers: apps with many typed words and a low dictation share are the best candidates for dictating more; apps with many reminders and few followed ones may suit exclusion; apps that already have a high share need no advice. Name the app, the numbers and one concrete suggestion. Do not invent figures, and say so when there is too little data. Use get-status for the pause state and the excluded apps. Only pause, resume, exclude or include when the user asks for it. A pause of more than 7 days is not possible; 'until further notice' is.

evals.input: @talkremind how much did I dictate today?
@talkremind in which apps should I dictate more, based on the last 30 days?
